description: Migration oracle for the transformerless -> uor-tless port. RE-PINNED 2026-08-01 (fourth time) for #327 (maintainer decision): teacher corpus scaled 150,000 -> 500,000 tokens (2,507 stories) and the #318 Phase B residual wiring landed, so the default emission is the TLA7 container (1,051,916 -> 1,346,836 bytes, kappa blake3:ef6a20f3...). RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-02 under D2 canonical deterministic math (#265): all pins and fixture bytes were unchanged. The threshold, context-codebook, class-signature and container kappas move with the new corpus; the token-side pins (codebook stages, stage books, token codes, shifts/exponents) are byte-identical to the prior era by construction (they derive from the source embedding table only). Era chain: TLA5 pin 2026-07-21 -> 1-term TLA6 pin 2026-07-30 (#243 Phase C) -> this. Prior-era containers (TLA6 1,051,916 blake3:cf64fe74...; TLA5 462,092 blake3:81db4406...) remain valid addresses of their own bytes. documented_linux_reference is HISTORICAL (b142c93-era), retained for reference only. RE-PINNED 2026-08-04 (fifth time) for #407 (maintainer decision, Casey sign-off): CTX_SAMPLE 6_000 -> 50_000 and era recompile against the current fixture corpus, motivated by the attribution sweep (PR #411: era self-consistency +1.4pp, sample-size +0.5-0.7pp; expected ~36.9%/7.95 WB vs prior 34.8%/8.4461 on the certifier store row). Compiled under canonical deterministic math (TLESS_CANONICAL_DETERMINISTIC=1); container kappa moved blake3:ef6a20f3... -> blake3:8fbf3f68... (1,346,836 bytes, size unchanged). Token-side pins (codebook stages, stage books, token codes, shifts/exponents) and the threshold vector are byte-identical to the prior era by construction; only the context codebooks, class signatures and container moved. Container kappa verified identical between canonical and platform-accelerated compiles on the build host (mode-invariant on linux/x86_64).
